text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити wins first place in the Japan
Cup and
basks in a rousing chorus of
cheers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She hears comments about her beauty,
but this
time, she smiles. The stands
erupt even louder in
response.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Impressed by her feat, I also tell her
she's
beautiful, a compliment she again
accepts with a
smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She says she doesn't care how others see
her.
Pretty or not, she'll never give up
running,
because as long as she's
running, she's being true
to herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
